note: Every figure image in content/figures. kind: figure, table, flowchart, map-legend, map-symbol, skill-sheet, parts-drawing, parts-table, form (cropped at 200 dpi from the 2026 MSHA PDFs) or page (the older full-page images). "page" is the printed rule-book page, "pdf_page" the PDF page. rule_ids lists the rule items whose "figures" include it, in no particular order; display order is the order inside each rule's "figures". caption_source says whether the caption is printed in the PDF or written plainly.
